task.ques: Look for a hotel in Paris with a user rating of 9 or higher and available for a 5-night stay starting January 15, 2027. The hotel should also offer free Wi-Fi and breakfast included in the price. Provide the name, location, and price per night.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Hôtel Saint-Louis - Jardin du Luxembourg — 63 Rue Madame, 6th arrondissement, 75006 Paris, France. Available January 15–20, 2027 (5 nights), for 2 adults in a Standard Double Room. Guest rating: 9.0/10. Free Wi-Fi and breakfast included. Average price: €216 per night (€1,080 displayed total for 5 nights), plus €55 total taxes and fees.

Evidence: final.png shows the dates, applied Hotels / Wonderful: 9+ / Free Wifi / Breakfast included filters, hotel name, 9.0 rating, breakfast-inclusive room, availability, and five-night price. The hotel's Booking.com page confirms the address: https://www.booking.com/hotel/fr/hotel-saint-louis-jardin-du-luxembourg.html
